record.question: It was the first time he had eaten a square meal __________ he had left the village.
record.explanation: Answer A: since. “It was the first time … since he had left” is the natural time relation (A). Independent check: The present-perfect construction “It was the first time he had eaten … since he had left” uses “since” for the point from which the period began. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/since. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
